name: Mind Flayer, Master Thief, Willow Satyr, Sower of Temptation — gain control for as long as
notes: Memory: project_gain_control_for_as_long_as_2026-10-16. Pattern B cut 'as long as you control this creature' out of 'gain control of target creature for as long as you control this creature' and left 'for', which the control parser kept in the target's words ('creature for'): 'for' became a required subtype, so the fired trigger's picker listed nothing and a target set anyway was refused by the fire-time check. The control effect also never got its duration, so Dragonlord Silumgar and Willbreaker kept the creature after they left. The control now takes the condition cut from that spot. 'This creature remains tapped' (Willow Satyr, Rubinia Soulsinger) is read as the card being tapped, and 'this creature remains on the battlefield' (Sower of Temptation) as the card being on the battlefield.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Sol Ring
scryfallData.flavor_text: Jace could see the sunlight in his Multiverse, but somewhere along the way, he lost the feel of its warmth.

scryfallData.name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
scryfallData.flavor_text: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.flavor_text: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."
